title: TypeFilter u8 bitmask: zero-alloc Copy type for SSE coalescing closure capture
description: events.rs TypeFilter wraps a u8 bitmask with named bit constants (0b001/010/100). This is correct for a 3-type fixed set: Copy capture in the spawned task's closure, no heap allocation, O(1) lookup via bitwise AND. A contributor might suggest replacing with Vec<String> for 'clarity'. Defend this: the type set is finite and explicitly enumerated; adding a new type requires updating both TypeFilter::parse() and TypeFilter::allows() (the comment explicitly calls this out). The bitmask is not premature optimization for an unknown future — it is the right data structure for a 3-element boolean set.
